nodes.title: SG-7 · Typed art and asset pipeline
nodes.body:
Context: frontend/src/art/*, frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts and game/src/assets/manifest already form most of a pipeline. Art modules return palette grids, generateAssets writes PNGs plus manifest entries, preload.ts and characters.ts read the manifest, and BootScene holds no duplicated frame constants. Desired behavior: close the remaining gaps, which are untyped art frames, no schema check inside generateAssets, and a stale manifest test that fails against the current manifest. Expected result: one typed pipeline with unchanged generated output. Why: the refactor goal needs a single source of truth for sprite metadata.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given ART_SOURCES, When generateAssets runs, Then every entry passes the manifest schema and the PNG output is byte-identical to today
- Given the boy sheet, When the manifest is read, Then frame size, frame count and animations come from character:boy-sheet and not from constants in BootScene
- Given the test suites in game/ and game/frontend/, When npm test and npm run typecheck run, Then both pass with no test deleted or skipped


## Scope
- In scope: Typed art grids and ArtSource type
- In scope: Schema validation inside generateAssets
- In scope: Manifest and boy sheet metadata tests
- In scope: Rewriting stale assetManifestFile test
- Out of scope: backend/ and the contribution API
- Out of scope: New art, art-style changes or new animations
- Out of scope: Phaser 4 migration
- Out of scope: Other refactor steps in the goal
- Preserve: Generated PNG bytes and committed manifest entries
- Preserve: Boy idle, walk and interact animations and frame counts
- Preserve: Same gameplay


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; a test that pinned internals is rewritten against behaviour
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- All three requirements are delivered and verified
- Both test suites and typechecks are green


## Non-functional requirements
- Generation stays deterministic with no timestamps


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Art modules return typed Grid frames through one shared ArtSource type
nodes.body:
Context: ArtSource.frames in frontend/src/art/sources.ts is number[][][] and Grid is declared in draw.ts, while boy.ts imports ArtSource back from sources.ts. Desired behavior: one types module exports Grid and ArtSource, and frames is Grid[]. Expected result: art modules and generateAssets share the same typed contract with no import cycle. Why: the pipeline must be typed end to end.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given ArtSource, When its frames field is inspected, Then its type is Grid[]
- Given every source in ART_SOURCES, When its frames are read, Then each frame is a rectangular integer grid and all frames of one source share the same size


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/art/types.ts
- In scope: draw.ts, sources.ts and boy.ts imports
- Out of scope: Changing any pixel value
- Preserve: Exports ART_SOURCES, BOY_SOURCES and Grid keep resolving for existing importers


## Technical constraints
- Same hard constraints as the intent; no file over 200 lines
- Generated output unchanged


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- Grid and ArtSource come from one module
- npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · generateAssets emits only manifest entries that pass manifest/schema.ts
nodes.body:
Context: runGenerateArt validates the merged manifest, but generateAssets itself returns entries unchecked. Desired behavior: generateAssets rejects an entry the schema refuses, naming the source id and the failing path. Expected result: a schema-valid manifest by construction with the same output as today. Why: the typed pipeline must guarantee its manifest.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given ART_SOURCES, When generateAssets runs, Then every entry parses with parseManifest
- Given a source whose entry violates the schema, When generateAssets runs, Then it throws an error naming the source id and the field path
- Given the boy sheet, When generated, Then dimensions are 448x48, frames are 32x48 x14 and animations idle, walk and interact are present


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts
- Out of scope: Changing the manifest schema
- Preserve: PNG bytes and entry shape
- Preserve: mergeManifest behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Same hard constraints as the intent
- game/src never imports game/frontend (the import goes frontend to game/src only)


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- Entries validated inside generateAssets
- Committed manifest still matches generated entries


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Boy animation frames and sheet metadata come from the manifest read by planPreload and the preloader
nodes.body:
Context: preload.ts reads frame size and path from the manifest, characters.ts reads animation frames and frameRate from it, and BootScene has no frame constants. tests/assetManifestFile.test.ts is stale: it looks for character:boy with 2 frames and reads files from frontend/public, and it now fails. Desired behavior: confirm and pin that wiring and rewrite the stale test against the real manifest. Expected result: a green suite that proves the boy sheet is described by the manifest only. Why: removes the last duplicated sprite metadata risk.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the committed manifest, When it is parsed, Then character:boy-sheet has 14 frames of 32x48 and idle, walk and interact animations
- Given the bedroom scene, When planPreload runs, Then character:boy-sheet is in load and nothing is unknown
- Given a manifest with different frames and frameRate, When createCharacters runs, Then the Phaser animation uses those manifest values


## Scope
- In scope: Rewriting tests/assetManifestFile.test.ts
- In scope: characters test using a custom manifest
- Out of scope: New animations
- Preserve: preload.ts and characters.ts behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Same hard constraints as the intent
- Rewrite the stale test, never delete or skip it


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- tests/assetManifestFile.test.ts passes
- Manifest-driven characters test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Validate each generated entry with parseAsset in generateAssets
nodes.body:
In generateAssets build each entry, validate it with parseAsset from @game/assets/manifest, and throw a clear error on failure. Output stays byte-identical.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid source, When generated, Then the entry is returned unchanged
- Given an invalid entry, When generated, Then Error 'invalid manifest entry <id>: <path>: <message>' is thrown


## Scope
- In scope: generateAssets function
- Out of scope: runGenerateArt, mergeManifest
- Preserve: Entry fields and order


## Technical constraints
- File stays under 200 lines
- Generated output unchanged
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/lib/generateAssets.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ-2

- Typecheck passes
- Existing generateAssets tests still pass

- None
nodes.summary: Run parseAsset on every entry before returning
nodes.description: In generateAssets build each entry, validate it with parseAsset from @game/assets/manifest, and throw a clear error on failure. Output stays byte-identical.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid source, When generated, Then the entry is returned unchanged
Given an invalid entry, When generated, Then Error 'invalid manifest entry <id>: <path>: <message>' is thrown

steps.action: Change the type-only import to also import the value parseAsset from '@game/assets/manifest'
steps.expected: parseAsset is available in the file

steps.action: Add a local helper that parses an entry with parseAsset and throws on failure, and replace both entries.push calls (spritesheet and image branches) with a call to the helper
steps.code: const accept = (entry: ManifestEntry): ManifestEntry => { const r = parseAsset(entry); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`invalid manifest entry ${entry.id}: ` + r.errors.map((e) => `${e.path}: ${e.message}`).join('; ')); return r.data; };\nentries.push(accept({...}));
steps.expected: Valid sources produce identical entries; invalid ones throw
